footer.tagline: Every scholarship you qualify for, in one place.
footer.scam: Fundora never charges fees, never asks for passwords or OTPs, and every Apply button goes to the official website.
footer.made: Made by students at BMS College of Engineering, Bengaluru.

home.title: Find every scholarship you qualify for
home.subtitle: Fill one profile. See every scholarship, loan, fee waiver and grant sorted into Eligible, Almost eligible and Not eligible, with a plain reason for each.

profile.title: Fill one profile
profile.text: Your course, marks, family income and background. About 5 minutes.

match.title: See your matches
match.text: Every scheme is checked against your profile, with the reason you qualify or don't.

apply.title: Apply on the official site
apply.text: Each Apply button opens the government or foundation portal. We never apply for you.

states.title: Clear answers, not guesses
states.almostReason: You need 60%; you have 57%, which is 3% short
states.notReason: This scheme is only for students from Maharashtra

safety.official: Every Apply button goes to the official portal.
safety.noIds: We never ask for your Aadhaar, bank account or portal passwords.
safety.encrypted: Your income, category and disability details are encrypted.
safety.delete: You can download or delete your data at any time.

auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to see your scholarship matches.
auth.signupSubtitle: One profile, every scholarship you qualify for.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Avoid common passwords like 12345678.
auth.consent: I have read the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy> and agree that Fundora can use my profile to match me with schemes.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, we've sent a reset link. It works for 1 hour. Check your spam folder too.
auth.resetSubtitle: Pick a password you don't use on other sites.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. You can log in now.
auth.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again, or request a new one.
auth.verifyDone: Your email is confirmed. You'll now get deadline reminders.
auth.verifyFailed: This link is invalid or has expired.
auth.verifyResendHint: Log in and use “Resend email” on your dashboard to get a new link.

profile.sensitiveNote: Used only to match schemes. Encrypted. Never shared.
profile.neverAsked: We never ask for your Aadhaar number, bank account number or portal passwords.

education.title: Your education
education.intro: Tell us what you're studying. Leave anything blank and come back to it later.

marks.title: Marks and attendance
marks.intro: Many schemes have a minimum percentage. Use the numbers on your marksheets.

family.title: Family and income
family.intro: Many schemes depend on family income and circumstances.

background.title: Category and background
background.intro: Some schemes are set aside for particular groups or states.

documents.title: Documents you have
documents.intro: Tick the ones you already have, so we can tell you what you still need. We only ask whether you have them, never for the numbers on them.
